definitions.design brief: A description of the problem, user, requirements, and deliverables.
definitions.constraint: A rule or bound that the design must obey.
definitions.assumption: A condition accepted for modeling that requires disclosure and checking.
definitions.validation: Testing whether a result satisfies specified criteria.
definitions.sensitivity: How a result changes as model inputs change.
definitions.limitation: A boundary on what available evidence supports.
definitions.portfolio: An organized collection of work, evidence, and revisions.
definitions.defense: An evidence-based explanation responding to critique.
definitions.revision: An improved version guided by testing and feedback.
